text:
PRADHAN MANTRI KISAN SAMMAN NIDHI (PM-KISAN)
1. Scheme Overview and Objectives
Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) is a Central Sector scheme launched by the Government of India in February 2019 to provide financial assistance to landholding farmer families across the country. The objective of the scheme is to augment the income of farmer families to help them meet financial requirements for agricultural inputs, seeds, fertilizers, and equipment, as well as domestic needs. Under the scheme, financial assistance of Rs. 6,000 per annum is provided to all eligible landholding farmer families. The benefit is disbursed directly into the Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts of beneficiary farmers through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) in three equal four-monthly installments of Rs. 2,000 each (Period 1: April-July, Period 2: August-November, Period 3: December-March).

text:
PM-KISAN ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA AND LAND OWNERSHIP REQUIREMENTS
2. Definition of Eligible Farmer Family
An eligible landholder farmer family is defined as a family consisting of husband, wife, and minor children who collectively own cultivable land registered in the official State or Union Territory land revenue records. The landholding must be in the name of the farmer or family member according to the land ownership database of the concerned State/UT. There is no restriction on maximum landholding size (the original 2-hectare cap was removed in June 2019 to cover all landholding farmers). The applicant must be an Indian citizen aged 18 years or above. Both male and female landholding farmers are eligible. Tenant farmers, sharecroppers, and landless agricultural labourers are not covered under PM-KISAN, as legal cultivable land ownership is a mandatory statutory requirement.

text:
PM-KISAN MANDATORY EXCLUSION CRITERIA (INELIGIBLE CATEGORIES)
3. Exclusion Categories
The following categories of beneficiaries of higher economic status are strictly excluded from receiving PM-KISAN benefits:
a. All Institutional Landholders.
b. Farmer families where one or more members belong to the following:
   i. Former and present holders of constitutional posts.
   ii. Former and present Ministers, State Ministers, Members of Parliament (Lok Sabha/Rajya Sabha), Members of State Legislative Assemblies (MLAs), Members of State Legislative Councils (MLCs), Mayors of Municipal Corporations, and Chairpersons of District Panchayats.
   iii. All serving or retired officers and employees of Central/State Government Ministries, Departments, PSUs, Autonomous Bodies, and Local Bodies (excluding Multi-Tasking Staff, Class IV, and Group D employees).
   iv. All superannuated or retired pensioners whose monthly pension is Rs. 10,000 or more (excluding MTS / Class IV / Group D).
   v. All persons who paid Income Tax in the last assessment year.
   vi. Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, and Architects registered with professional bodies and carrying on active practice.

text:
PM-KISAN MANDATORY PREREQUISITES FOR INSTALLMENT DISBURSEMENT
4. Three Mandatory Verification Conditions
To receive PM-KISAN installment payments without stoppage, every farmer must fulfill three mandatory conditions:
1. Aadhaar e-KYC: Beneficiary must complete biometric authentication at a CSC centre, OTP-based e-KYC using Aadhaar-linked mobile number, or facial authentication via the official PM-KISAN Mobile App.
2. Land Seeding & Verification: Land records must be verified and seeded by State Nodal Revenue Officers in the Bhulekh database.
3. Active Bank Account with Aadhaar-DBT Seeding: Bank account must be linked with Aadhaar and mapped to the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) DBT gateway.
Required Documents for Registration:
- Aadhaar Card of farmer
- Land ownership records (Khata/Khesra/Patta document)
- Active Bank Account Passbook / Statement
- Mobile Number linked to Aadhaar.

text:
PM-KISAN APPLICATION PROCESS, STATUS TRACKING, AND PORTAL DETAILS
5. Registration and Portals
Application Status: Continuous year-round 24x7 online registration is open without cutoff deadlines. How to Apply:
- Online Mode: Farmers can self-register on the official portal https://pmkisan.gov.in under the 'Farmer Corner' by clicking 'New Farmer Registration'.
- CSC Mode: Farmers can visit their nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar and land records.
Application Verification: After submission, application is sent to the local Village Revenue Officer / Patwari and State Nodal Officer for land record verification.
Tracking Status: Farmers can check their payment and e-KYC status using the 'Know Your Status' feature on pmkisan.gov.in by entering their Registration Number or Aadhaar Number.
Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Linkage: All PM-KISAN beneficiaries can obtain subsidized credit through simplified one-page KCC application.

text:
PRIME MINISTER'S EMPLOYMENT GENERATION PROGRAMME (PMEGP)
1. Scheme Overview and Objectives
The Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) is a major credit-linked subsidy programme administered by the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MoMSME), Government of India. Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC) is the single National Nodal Agency for implementation. At State level, the scheme is implemented through State KVIC Directorates, State Khadi and Village Industries Boards (KVIBs), District Industries Centres (DICs), and banks.
Objectives:
- To generate continuous and sustainable self-employment opportunities in rural as well as urban areas across India.
- To establish micro-enterprises in manufacturing, services, and business sectors.
- To bring together widely dispersed traditional artisans and unemployed youth to increase per capita income.

text:
PMEGP MAXIMUM PROJECT COSTS AND MARGIN MONEY SUBSIDY RATES
2. Project Cost Ceiling
- Manufacturing Sector: Maximum admissible project cost is Rs. 50 Lakhs.
- Service / Business Sector: Maximum admissible project cost is Rs. 20 Lakhs.
3. Beneficiary Contribution and Government Subsidy Structure:
A. General Category Beneficiaries:
- Own Contribution: 10% of total project cost.
- Margin Money Subsidy: 15% in Urban areas, 25% in Rural areas.
B. Special Categories (SC, ST, OBC, Minorities, Women, Ex-Servicemen, Physically Handicapped, NER, Hill/Border Areas, Aspirational Districts):
- Own Contribution: 5% of total project cost.
- Margin Money Subsidy: 25% in Urban areas, 35% in Rural areas.
Balance funding (60% to 75% of project cost) is provided as term loan and working capital by financing banks.

text:
PMEGP ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA AND EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS
4. Eligibility Conditions
- Age: Any individual aged 18 years and above is eligible. There is no upper age limit.
- Minimum Educational Qualification: For setting up manufacturing projects costing above Rs. 10 Lakhs and service projects costing above Rs. 5 Lakhs, the beneficiary must have passed at least Class 8th examination.
- Eligible Entities: Individuals, Self Help Groups (SHGs) not availing other subsidies, Institutions registered under Societies Registration Act 1860, Production Co-operative Societies, and Charitable Trusts.
- New Units Only: Subsidy is admissible only for newly established micro-enterprises. Existing units or units already funded under PMRY, REGP, or other government subsidy schemes are ineligible.
- Income Ceiling: There is no personal or family income ceiling for applying under PMEGP.

text:
PMEGP APPLICATION PROCEDURE, REQUIRED DOCUMENTS, AND EDP TRAINING
5. Application Procedure and Mandatory EDP Training
- Online Application: Applications must be submitted 100% online through the KVIC PMEGP e-Portal: https://www.kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal/pmegphome/index.jsp.
- Selection & Bank Sanction: Application is verified by the implementing agency (KVIC/KVIB/DIC) and forwarded electronically to the designated financing bank branch. The bank appraises the project and sanctions credit based on techno-economic viability.
- Mandatory EDP Training: All sanctioned beneficiaries must undergo Entrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP) training (5 to 10 days) through online/offline mode before release of the first loan installment.
- Margin Money Lock-in: Margin Money subsidy is kept in a separate Term Deposit Receipt (TDR) for 3 years, after which it is adjusted against the loan account subject to physical verification.
Required Documents:
1. Aadhaar Card
2. Detailed Project Report (DPR)
3. Special category / Caste Certificate (if claiming 25%-35% subsidy)
4. Rural area certificate from local revenue authority (if claiming rural rate)
5. Class 8th Pass Certificate / Marksheet (for projects > 10L manufacturing or > 5L service).

text:
PM STREET VENDOR'S ATMANIRBHAR NIDHI (PM SVANIDHI)
1. Scheme Overview and Objectives
PM SVANidhi is a Central Sector micro-credit scheme launched by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) to provide affordable working capital loans to urban street vendors whose businesses were impacted during the COVID-19 pandemic. The scheme facilitates collateral-free working capital loans with interest subsidy and digital transaction cashbacks to encourage formal financial inclusion and digital adoption.
2. Three Graduated Loan Tranches:
- 1st Tranche Loan: Up to Rs. 10,000 with a repayment tenure of 1 year.
- 2nd Tranche Loan: Up to Rs. 20,000 for vendors who repay their 1st tranche loan on or before schedule.
- 3rd Tranche Loan: Up to Rs. 50,000 for vendors who successfully service and repay their 2nd tranche loan.
No collateral or third-party guarantee is required for any tranche.

text:
PM SVANIDHI INTEREST SUBSIDY, DIGITAL CASHBACKS, AND BENEFIT STRUCTURE
3. Key Financial Incentives:
- Interest Subsidy: An interest subsidy of 7% per annum is provided on timely or early repayment of loan installments. The subsidy amount is credited directly into the borrower's bank account on a quarterly basis via DBT.
- Digital Transaction Cashback: Vendors who conduct transactions digitally using UPI or QR codes receive monthly cashbacks ranging from Rs. 50 to Rs. 100 per month (up to Rs. 1,200 per year), credited directly to their bank account.
- Early Repayment Incentive: There is zero penalty or foreclosure charge for pre-payment or early repayment of the loan. Early repayment automatically unlocks eligibility for the next higher loan tranche (Rs. 20,000 or Rs. 50,000) and enhances credit score.

text:
PM SVANIDHI BENEFICIARY ELIGIBILITY, VENDOR IDENTIFICATION, AND DOCUMENTS
4. Beneficiary Eligibility
The scheme is available to all street vendors vending in urban areas on or before March 24, 2020, as well as newly identified vendors who meet any of the following criteria:
a. Street vendors possessing a Certificate of Vending (CoV) or Identity Card issued by the Urban Local Body (ULB).
b. Vendors identified in the ULB street vendor survey but who have not yet received a CoV or Identity Card.
c. Vendors who were left out of the ULB survey or started vending after the survey, possessing a Letter of Recommendation (LoR) issued by the ULB / Town Vending Committee (TVC).
d. Vendors from surrounding peri-urban or rural areas who vend within the geographical jurisdiction of the ULB.
Required Documents:
- Aadhaar Card / Voter ID Card
- Certificate of Vending (CoV) or ULB Letter of Recommendation (LoR)
- Active Bank Account with IFSC
- Aadhaar-linked Mobile Number.
Application Portal: https://pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or via CSC / Banking Correspondents.

text:
PRADHAN MANTRI SHRAM YOGI MAANDHAN (PM-SYM)
1. Scheme Overview and Pension Benefits
Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan (PM-SYM) is a voluntary and contributory pension scheme launched by the Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India, to provide old-age social security to unorganized workers. Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) is the Pension Fund Manager responsible for pension payout.
Benefits:
- Minimum Assured Pension: Each subscriber receives a minimum assured monthly pension of Rs. 3,000 per month upon attaining the age of 60 years.
- Family Pension: During receipt of pension, if the subscriber dies, the spouse is entitled to receive 50% of the pension (Rs. 1,500 per month) as family pension. Family pension is applicable strictly to the spouse.
- Death before 60 Years: If the subscriber dies before age 60, the spouse can continue the scheme by paying regular monthly contributions or exit the scheme and receive accumulated contributions along with interest.

text:
PM-SYM ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA, AGE LIMITS, AND EXCLUSIONS
2. Eligibility Conditions:
- Target Group: Unorganized workers (e.g., street vendors, head loaders, brick kiln workers, cobblers, rag pickers, domestic workers, washermen, rickshaw pullers, landless agricultural labourers, construction workers, beedi workers, handloom workers, agricultural workers).
- Entry Age: Must be between 18 and 40 years of age.
- Monthly Income Ceiling: Monthly income must not exceed Rs. 15,000 per month.
3. Exclusion Criteria (Who Cannot Apply):
- Must NOT be engaged in the organized sector or covered under statutory social security schemes including National Pension System (NPS), Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), or Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC).
- Must NOT be an Income Tax assessee.

text:
PM-SYM 50:50 MATCHING CONTRIBUTION STRUCTURE AND REGISTRATION PORTAL
4. Contribution Chart (50:50 Matching Basis):
PM-SYM is a 50:50 contributory scheme. The beneficiary contributes a monthly amount determined by their entry age, and an equal matching contribution is deposited by the Central Government into the pension fund.
- Entry Age 18: Beneficiary pays Rs. 55/month (Central Government contributes Rs. 55/month).
- Entry Age 29: Beneficiary pays Rs. 100/month (Central Government contributes Rs. 100/month).
- Entry Age 40: Beneficiary pays Rs. 200/month (Central Government contributes Rs. 200/month).
Contributions are auto-debited monthly from the subscriber's bank account until age 60.
5. Registration and Portals:
- Enrolment is available at all Common Service Centres (CSCs) across India or through self-enrolment at https://maandhan.in.
- Required Documents: Aadhaar Card and Savings Bank Account / Jan Dhan Account with IFSC.
- Upon successful enrolment, the subscriber is issued a PM-SYM Pension Card with a unique Pension Account Number.

text:
PRADHAN MANTRI UJJWALA YOJANA (PMUY / UJJWALA 2.0)
1. Scheme Overview and Objectives
Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY / Ujjwala 2.0) is a flagship welfare scheme launched by the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas (MoPNG), Government of India, to provide clean cooking fuel (LPG) to women from poor and vulnerable households. The scheme aims to empower women, protect health from hazardous indoor air pollution caused by burning firewood and coal, and prevent deforestation.
2. Financial Assistance and Benefits Provided:
- Deposit-Free LPG Connection: The Central Government provides financial support of Rs. 1,600 for each 14.2 kg connection (or Rs. 1,150 for a 5 kg cylinder). This covers the security deposit of the cylinder, pressure regulator, LPG hose pipe, domestic gas consumer card (DGCC) book, and inspection/installation charges.
- Free First Refill: In addition to the deposit-free connection, Ujjwala 2.0 provides the first LPG refill cylinder completely free of charge.
- Free Gas Stove: A single-burner or two-burner LPG stove (hotplate) is provided free of cost to the beneficiary at the time of connection installation.

text:
PMUY UJJWALA 2.0 ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA AND TARGET BENEFICIARIES
3. Eligibility Conditions:
- The applicant must be an adult woman aged 18 years or above.
- No existing LPG connection: There must be no other LPG connection in the applicant's household from any Oil Marketing Company (IOCL/BPCL/HPCL).
- Eligible Categories: Adult woman belonging to any of the following:
  a. Households identified in SECC 2011 Deprivation Criteria.
  b. Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) households.
  c. Beneficiaries of Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY - Gramin).
  d. Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) ration cardholders.
  e. Most Backward Classes (MBC).
  f. Tea and Ex-Tea Garden Tribes.
  g. Forest Dwellers, Resident Islanders, or River Islanders.
  h. Any poor household under the 14-Point Self-Declaration.

text:
PMUY UJJWALA 2.0 SPECIAL MIGRANT CONCESSIONS AND APPLICATION PROCESS
4. Special Provisions for Migrant Workers in Ujjwala 2.0:
- Migrant workers are NOT required to submit ration cards or permanent address proofs from their home state.
- A self-declaration of family composition and current residential address is sufficient to avail the deposit-free LPG connection.
5. Required Documents:
- Aadhaar Card of the applicant woman as Proof of Identity and Address.
- Aadhaar Cards of all adult family members residing together.
- Active Bank Account with IFSC (seeded with Aadhaar for DBT targeted LPG subsidies).
- Ration Card / Family Composition Document (or self-declaration for migrants).
6. Application Method and Official Portal:
- Apply online at the official portal: https://www.pmuy.gov.in or directly at the nearest LPG distributor of Bharatgas, Indane, or HP Gas.
- Continuous year-round application processing with zero application fees.
